title: PRISMT: transformers for trial-structured neural and behavioral recordings, driven from MATLAB
description: PRISMT lets experimentalists train the PRISMt transformer on trial-structured recordings (brain activity, behavior, or both) from a MATLAB app, without writing code. It classifies trial conditions and learns the structure of the recordings with a masked autoencoder, tests on held-out animals by cross-validation, and compares every result with simple reference models. The supplementary manual (docs/PRISMT_supplementary.pdf) documents the app, the settings, the dataset format and how to read the results.
